intro.text: Welcome to the Hand Building Factory. Grab the glowing part with the trigger, and place it in the blue outline.

menu.text: Press A or X to open the menu.

tool-on.text: Screwdriver ready. Touch its tip to a screw.

mount-one.text: Mounted. Press B or Y for the screwdriver, then touch the tip to the screw.

mount-many.text: Mounted. Press B or Y for the screwdriver, then touch the tip to each screw.

arrows.text: Follow the yellow arrows to the screws.

part-palm.text: Next: the palm. Pick it up at the printer, and place it on the hand stand.

part-servo-base.text: Next: the wrist motor. It rides the conveyor, and goes on the back of the wrist.

part-servo-f1.text: Next: the index motor. It rides the conveyor, and goes behind the index finger.

part-servo-f2.text: Next: the middle motor. It rides the conveyor, and goes behind the middle finger.

part-servo-f3.text: Next: the ring motor. It rides the conveyor, and goes behind the ring finger.

part-servo-f4.text: Next: the little motor. It rides the conveyor, and goes behind the little finger.

part-thumb-base.text: Next: the thumb base. Pick it up at the printer, and place it on the side of the palm.

part-finger-index.text: Next: the index finger. Pick it up at the printer, and place it above the palm.

part-finger-middle.text: Next: the middle finger. Pick it up at the printer, and place it above the palm.

part-finger-ring.text: Next: the ring finger. Pick it up at the printer, and place it above the palm.

part-finger-little.text: Next: the little finger. Pick it up at the printer, and place it above the palm.

part-thumb-segments.text: Next: the thumb segments. Pick them up at the printer, and place them beside the thumb base.

part-upper-cover.text: Last part: the upper cover. Pick it up at the printer, and place it over the back of the hand.
